reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 AI editorial review of all 32 original low-typing questions: reviewed full German sentences, intended noun senses, each of four offered choices, accepted answers, hints, bilingual explanations, and distinct scenarios. Sixteen source rows authored; three deferred for conflicting senses, register or level; Antrag mapped as a duplicate of existing objectives. Existing production and draft targets and previous enrichment catalogs checked. Inherited CEFR labels remain unverified; structural CI is not independent linguistic review, rights clearance, certification or measured transfer. All targets pending and publicationApproved=false.
